# speckit stats

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Read-only history analytics over the operational database plane (feature 032, ADR-0053)

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit stats [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.
